items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Such as Papa Celestine and like Prince Bacturo and a lot of old old records, a lot of old timers.

ctx.x: Wasn't very old then at all?
No, he wasn't very young. He'd be around the age of some of the older musicians. Such as Papa Celestine and like Prince Bacturo and a lot of old old records, a lot of old timers.
And he started on trumpet? Was that his main instrument all his life?
